label: rem:direct-limit-lusztig
title: Direct limit algebra and the Lusztig integral form
html:
One explicitly realises the algebra \mathcal{A}_\infty (direct limit algebra) as the Lusztig integral form of the quantised enveloping algebra \mathcal{U}_q(\mathfrak{su}(2)) [lusztig1993]. At each level n, one obtains the fibre algebra \mathrm{SU}_{q_n}(2) by specialising the \mathbb{Z}[q,q^{-1}]-form \mathcal{U}^{\mathbb{Z}}_q(\mathfrak{su}(2)) (substrate parameter) along q \mapsto q_n \in k^{\times}. The direct limit inherits the divided power basis (E^{(m)}, F^{(m)}, K^{\pm 1}) from the integral form. The q-deformed scaling function \exp_q(r) - 1 (equation eq:q-exp) regulates the transition between the divided power bases of the space-like and time-like resolvents.

The specialisation is flat because the divided-power basis of the integral form is free over \mathbb{Z}[q,q^{-1}] [lusztig1993], so it remains a basis after q \mapsto q_n.
